profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer who's really passionate about game development. In my free time, I participate in game jams in order to hone my skills as a developer. I find all aspects of game development incredibly intriguing and have worked on networking, optimization and general feature development within this domain.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Ported 3D AR scan and design app to the Quest 2 as a PoC for immersive VR experiences. Integrated Niantic’s VPS SDK into our app to leverage persistent AR experiences between sessions. Improved gameplay on various in-app minigames as well as overall app feel. Designed and implemented a 3D model auto-cropping algorithm using octrees and ray-casting

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a team to develop two multiplayer virtual reality games. Designed and implemented an in game panel with performance metrics for the virtual reality experiences. Leveraged and modified UE4’s UMG and Statistic systems to display dynamically changing debug information. Developed object pooling for increased efficiency and performance of the different experiences. Designed scripts to optimize the compilation and build processes, as well as the distribution of the applications to different machines

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented an augmented reality native and web application with facial recognition capabilities. Wrote native application in Unity/C# and web application in HTML/Javascript. Deployed an AWS server for communication between the native or web application and the AWS Rekognition service. Met with various companies to discuss proof of concepts and test various products.

positions.title: Lab Intern
positions.description: Ran electrochemical experiments on carbon steel samples in order to measure corrosion and pitting rates of the sample when immersed in different solutions. Also wrote Fortran scripts to simulate corrosion experiments given different input parameters.
